operation_details.item: The user's Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the campaign planning going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m reviewing the media mix and making sure the allocation still supports the campaign goals.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What does the current split look like?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget, Channel 2 receives 30%, and Channel 3 receives 20%.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That leaves 10% outside those three channels. Are you planning to revisit the allocation soon?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the budget allocation is reviewed quarterly, so the next review will be part of the regular planning cycle.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the 40% allocation for Channel 1, while keeping the allocations for Channels 2 and 3 and the review cycle.
